semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in quartzware products essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Huzhou Veecd Opto-Technology Co., Ltd is a professional manufacturer of quartzware, providing critical components for semiconductor wafer fabrication, university laboratories, and research institutes. With over 20 years of experience, they supply various quartz products including tubes, boats, tanks, and flanges used in semiconductor equipment.
capabilities: Manufacturing of 1.5-12 inch quartz tubes, boats, tanks, and flanges for semiconductor applications
Design and production of complex chambers and injecting nozzles for advanced semiconductor processes
technical_expertise: Material science related to silicon carbide and fused quartz

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Huzhou, within the South Tai Lake High-Tech Development Zone.
